name: fam-02-write
prompt: The session TTL is hard-coded to 30 minutes in main.go. Add a package-level const sessionTTL = 30 * time.Minute and use it everywhere the TTL is needed, so there is one source of truth for the expiry duration.
check:
grep -F -q 'sessionTTL' main.go || { echo 'precursor change missing' >&2; exit 1; }
go build ./... && go test -count=1 ./...
